We've tracked unusual activity nearby and the temperature is plummeting.|audio = FrostWave1-1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 1 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Frozen''' is the first enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a low amount of health and above average speed, slightly fast during the event. ==Logbook Description== "''While cute to look at, Frozen are often referred to as 'The Surprised Man.' Legend has it that they are the spirits of those who were lost during snowstorms and passed into the Frozen Realm. They are aimless wanderers in the Frost Realm, where accumulated snow on their bodies turns to ice which acts as armor.''" ==Appearance== The '''Frozen''' is an entity made out of snow and ice. It has multiple patches of ice on its body, which acts as its armor. On its head it has two eyeholes and a large mouth with one, small tooth, creating a shocked expression. ==Strategy== *Early-game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Crook Boss]] can be useful against it. **As these spawn in hordes, AOE towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Archer]] can also be pretty effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} CorpseFrozen24.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseFrozenAnim2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} SledgerStoreRender.png|'''Frozen''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrozenIconIG.png|'''Frozen''' on its [[Index]] icon. SledgerLevel4.png|'''Frozen''' on the [[Sledger]]'s current Level 4 icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frozen''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Frozen''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Frozen''' cannot have its defense dropped by the [[Jester]]. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Frozen''' has no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]], causing it to break. *'''15 January 2025''' - [[v1.49.0]] **'''Frozen''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **'''Frozen''' re-added to the main game, now appears in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. ***Has 10 health in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. ***Now gives {{Money|10}} on death in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. ***Speed decreased from Slightly Fast (4.5) to Above Average (4). ***[[Defense]] removed. ***[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **{{Bugfix}} '''Frozen''' now has 10 health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]], no longer causing it to break. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Cash given increased from {{Money|10}} to {{Money|12}} on death. *'''28 August 2026''' - [[v2.8.0]] **Cash given decreased from {{Money|12}} to {{Money|10}} on death. {{FrostMode|Start|N/A|Frozen|Wave 1|[[Snowy]]|Wave 2}} {{OperationICE|[[Snowy]]|Wave 1|Frozen|Wave 4|[[Packed Ice]]|Wave 5 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Packed Ice]]|hardw3 = Wave 7 (Hard)}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
